what_this_is: A held-out set of rephrasings of every boundary probe in hive.json, written on 2026-10-23 by an agent instructed not to open hive.json, build_hive.py, the console or docs/HIVE.md, so it never saw the routing rules it tests. It measures how the console generalises to wording nobody tuned it on. Do not tune routes against it: the day a rule is written to catch one of these, this stops being a held-out measurement. Add a fresh set instead.
ceiling_note: Measured 2026-10-23: 5 of 60 rephrasings were routed to an agent's in-scope rule — waved through. The build fails if that count rises. Lower the ceiling when a route change brings it down; never raise it.
